usage: Copy or adapt these local-first HTML motion templates after writing workflow/motion-template-selection.json. Exact Chinese text should remain deterministic in HTML/SVG/CSS layers.

templates.signature: large editorial type, evidence card, proof seal, semantic subtitle rail

templates.engine: CSS variables + Web Animations API progress driver
templates.signature: timecode-bound nodes, progress beam, active beat detail panel
verification: node state changes at beat timestamps

templates.engine: CSS transforms + SVG connector motion + pointer-responsive parallax
templates.signature: evidence cards, animated red thread, focus lens, stateful highlight
near-black stage, large white character-by-character title, optional final phrase, caption-safe lead-in
verification: first-frame blackness when rendered in production

templates.signature: black spatial stage, subtle purple horizon glow, kinetic promise, gradient CTA, floating UI pills

templates.engine: SVG path trace + deterministic progress driver
templates.signature: sourced line chart, axis grid, traced curve, focus dot, endpoint/value callout, source footnote

externalPlatformRouting.gsap: Use for advanced timeline, SVG path, scroll-like scrub, or MotionPath choreography when local CSS/WAAPI becomes too complex.
externalPlatformRouting.motion: Use for React app-like transitions, shared layout, gesture, and state-driven interaction.
externalPlatformRouting.remotion: Borrow frame-driven timing, interpolate/easing vocabulary, transition accounting, and deterministic text animation rules; do not switch renderers without a migration plan.
externalPlatformRouting.animejs: Use for compact imperative timeline/stagger/SVG animation.
externalPlatformRouting.d3: Use only when generated scales, joins, bins, grouped bars, scatter plots, or other data transforms would make hand-authored SVG brittle.
externalPlatformRouting.manim: Use as a scene-level insert only for formula-driven curves, physics paths, geometric proofs, or parametric relationships; keep exact Chinese text/subtitles in the main workflow.
externalPlatformRouting.rive: Use only with authorized .riv assets and clear state-machine value.
externalPlatformRouting.lottie: Use only with authored or licensed .json/.lottie assets for compact icon/illustration loops.
externalPlatformRouting.galacean: Use as an optional visual-effects layer for project-authored or licensed particles, fireworks, 2D/3D effects, energy beams, scans, and transition bursts; keep subtitles and exact text in deterministic HTML/SVG/CSS layers and write workflow/galacean-effects-plan.json.
externalPlatformRouting.threejs: Use for meaningful 3D scenes; verify nonblank canvas and framing.
